_comment: Goofy library for just volleyball (build 26827091). Full tier only: off in public lobbies / Quick Match.
EVERYTHING HERE IS OFF BY DEFAULT (1.0 / 0 / false = the game's own ball, players and rules).
big_ball: ball size multiplier, e.g. 1.5 (real hitbox via BallPhysics.radius; the visual follows the hitbox, never double-scaled).
ball_physics: edits the game's shared res://game/ball/ball_physics.tres. gravity_scale / bounce_scale are
multipliers (1.0 = off); any BallPhysics property can also be set by name, e.g. "floor_friction": 0.5.
player_scale: size of every player (1.0 = off).
max_hits_per_team: 0 = game rule (3), or 1-10. no_double_hit: one player may touch twice in a row.
Both are also rows in the custom-lobby Modifiers panel; the host's values apply (host-enforced).
time_scale (slow-mo, e.g. 0.6) is opt-in: add it yourself.
ball_params: the full ball library (156 params: physics, drag, speed caps, bounce, spin/curve, hitboxes, hit range, visuals),
keyed by id, e.g. {"ball.floor_bounce": 0.8, "flight.air_drag": 0.3, "player.reach": {"mul": 1.5}}. Empty = off.
Live offline (Free Play / practice / offline solo / menu) and in LAN / private / friends lobbies; list + ranges in docs/GOOFY-BALL.md.

In a LAN / private / friends MATCH every gameplay setting (ball + player params, time_scale) follows the HOST; visual-only params (trail, outline, colours) stay yours. Public: local only, stock physics.

Settings tab and the Mods panel: big_ball, player_scale, ball_physics gravity/bounce, flight.air_drag, flight.curve_scale, time_scale and the rules are gameplay settings now (Settings > mods, docs/GAMEPLAY-SETTINGS.md). Ported fields apply live from either UI; values here are imported once and later file edits of those keys still apply. Overrides still need Save.
